subject: [PATCH v8 07/30] x86: mm: add PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch adds helpers for managing PMD-mapped anonymous huge pages (THPs) that are swapped out and then brought back in. The new helpers, which reuse the existing _PAGE_SWP_EXCLUSIVE bit, allow a PMD-mapped THP to be kept mapped across a swap round-trip. This is necessary because x86-64 encodes swap PMDs exactly like swap PTEs, and 32-bit x86 has different behavior for this bit. The patch adds assertions to ensure that the helpers are only used on architectures that support them.
